analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 crore revenue milestone with significant growth in EBITDA and profit after tax. The company successfully commissioned its new Alu-Zinc (Galvalume) line and augmented its existing colour-coated line during the year. Management has outlined future revenue targets of INR 1,500 crore for FY 2026-27 and INR 3,000 crore for FY 2028-29, supported by planned capacity expansions including a new colour-coated line and a cold-rolling mill. Manaksia Steels reported its financial performance for FY 2024-25, noting a decline in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT while sales tonnage increased by 15%. The company undertook capital expansion projects including an integrated Alu-Zinc production line and a colour coating manufacturing line funded through internal accruals.

guidance.claim: The company stated that the new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 110,800 TPA would result in consolidated annual revenues of 1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The colour coating manufacturing line investment is expected to generate annual revenue of 500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates that the new Alu-Zinc product will boost production capacity, revenue, and profit realization.
guidance.quote: This new addition is set to boost overall production capacity, revenue, and profit realization.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of 40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line to enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that EBITDA margin weakened due to a decrease in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global economic fragility and weakened demand in the steel sector have resulted in lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme of colour coating manufacturing line is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning of its new capacities.
management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning its new capacities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
